description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 11.12.2017 to 17.12.2017
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It exercises regulatory authority under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine how customs calculations will be made. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework implementation for customs matters.
